merlin.description: You know who the evil players are. If good completes three quests, the assassin gets one guess at who Merlin is.

percival.description: One of the two players you see is Merlin and the other is Morgana, who is evil.

john.description: You are a loyal servant of good with no special power. You know who Percival is.

morgana.description: You are evil. Percival sees you and Merlin as indistinguishable. You may lie.

assassin.description: You are evil. If good completes three quests, you get one guess at who Merlin is. You may lie.
